name: Containerised hybrid power modules (solar, storage, gensets)
applications: diesel displacement under rental or BOOM contracts
principle: Factory-integrated containers or skids combine solar PV, battery storage and diesel/gas gensets under one hybrid controller, so a remote site replaces part of its diesel generation within days to weeks of arrival. Aggreko delivers such plants as rental or build-own-operate contracts (relocatable solar farms plus its containerised Y.Cube batteries), BoxPower ships pre-engineered container microgrids from 5 kW to 20 MW, and fold-out PV containers such as SolarContainer's 140 kWp unit install in hours.

advantages: Cuts diesel consumption by roughly 5-20% at mine sites with solar fractions already proven
Deploys in days to weeks and relocates between sites
Offered as a service (rental or BOOM), so the site owner takes no capital risk
limitations: Diesel remains the night and cloudy-day baseload; savings depend on the solar resource
Module ratings are small (tens of kW to a few MW), so large loads need many modules
Relocatable arrays and batteries cost more per kW than fixed utility-scale plant
